## Standing operator rules
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”
- “Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.”
- Run “avatar-cdn-batched-migration” between other work; “Run these steps in order, one at a time.”
- Do not disable idempotency middleware; it caused duplicate staging invoices.
- Never write to frozen `ledgerly-exports-stg`; staging exports go only to `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`.
- Treat fields ending in `_secret`, `_token`, or `_fingerprint` as restricted and copy them only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`.
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”

## Current objective
Fix JPY amounts receiving two decimal places in `ledgerly/money.py`. PDF export migration is paused; avatar migration steps 3–8 remain queued.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Disable idempotency middleware: duplicate staging invoices.
- Retain `_last_batch`: reference leakage.
- Bespoke billing-filter groups: omitted destinations and duplicated options.

## Recent work
Search rebuilds were optimized to 1.19s for 5,000 invoices via tenant scoping and 100-item embedding chunks; 33 search tests passed. Shared embedder wiring passed 9 command tests. A `bulk_upsert` transaction was just added and remains untested.
